# Production entry lens 0.1.1

The criteria a solution must meet before it goes into production, applied in the production entry assessment (standard, section 8.1) on top of the core lens and whichever AI lenses its profiles bring in. The core lens asks whether the design is fit for purpose; this lens asks whether what was built is that design, whether the evidence for this version exists and says what it must, whether the assessments the design handed over have returned, whether the solution can be run, released and recovered, and whether what remains has been accepted by someone entitled to accept it. It reads evidence of the build. It does not repeat the cybersecurity, privacy, AI impact or conformity assessments; it reads their outcomes.

Applies to the `production-entry` assessment. Source: [`standards/assessment/lenses/production.yaml`](../../standards/assessment/lenses/production.yaml).

## BLD: As built

Is what was built the design that was assessed, at the version being released?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRD-BLD-01](prd-bld-01.md) | Is the design a solution design, accepted, with no open consideration, and has this version had an endorsed design review whose conditions are closed? | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-BLD-02](prd-bld-02.md) | Does an as-built record show the built solution matches this version of the design, with every departure either designed in a new version or recorded as a decision? | blocker | both |
| [PRD-BLD-03](prd-bld-03.md) | Are the automated fitness functions running in the delivery pipeline or continuously, and passing on the release candidate? | major | both |

## EVD: Evidence

Was the evidence produced against this version, and does it cover what it must?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRD-EVD-01](prd-evd-01.md) | Was every piece of evidence the assessment relies on produced against the version being released? | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-EVD-02](prd-evd-02.md) | Do acceptance tests show the functional scenarios work end to end? | major | both |

## HND: Hand-overs

Have the assessments this one does not make returned, with acceptable outcomes?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRD-HND-01](prd-hnd-01.md) | Has every assessment the design handed over returned an outcome for this version that is not a failure? | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-HND-02](prd-hnd-02.md) | Are the conditions and residual risks those assessments returned accepted by the person each one names? | major | reviewer |

## OPS: Run

Is there a team, a runbook, alerting and an operational readiness review behind the solution?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRD-OPS-01](prd-ops-01.md) | Is a team named to run the solution, with its hours, on-call cover and escalation? | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-OPS-02](prd-ops-02.md) | Does every SLO alert the support team when it is at risk, and is the solution in the monitoring it will be run with? | major | both |
| [PRD-OPS-03](prd-ops-03.md) | Is there a runbook, and has an operational readiness review of this version passed? | major | tool |

## REL: Release and recovery

Have rollback, recovery, load and cutover been exercised rather than written down?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRD-REL-01](prd-rel-01.md) | Has rollback of this release been tested, and is the point after which rollback becomes recovery known? | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-REL-02](prd-rel-02.md) | Has recovery been tested against the stated recovery time and recovery point objectives? | major | tool |
| [PRD-REL-03](prd-rel-03.md) | Has a load test exercised the high-importance performance and reliability scenarios at the expected peak? | major | both |
| [PRD-REL-04](prd-rel-04.md) | Are the cutover, any data migration, and the retirement of what the solution replaces planned and owned? | major | reviewer |

## RSK: Residual risk

Is everything carried into production owned and accepted by someone entitled to accept it?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRD-RSK-01](prd-rsk-01.md) | Does every risk, debt item and accepted finding carried into production have an owner entitled to accept it, and a date? | blocker | both |
| [PRD-RSK-02](prd-rsk-02.md) | Are the conditions of this assessment each owned and dated, and is the first periodic assessment scheduled? | major | reviewer |

## AI: Model and agent readiness

Do the release candidate's evals pass, and do an agent's limits and kill switch work in fact?

| Criterion | Question | Severity | Decided by |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PRD-AI-01](prd-ai-01.md) | Do the gating evals pass on the release candidate? | blocker | tool |
| [PRD-AI-02](prd-ai-02.md) | Are drift monitoring and at least one online eval switched on for every model-backed element? | major | tool |
| [PRD-AI-03](prd-ai-03.md) | Have the agent's limits, approval gates and kill switch been shown to work, without the agent's cooperation? | blocker | tool |
